avoid_supplements.name: Red Yeast Rice
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Contains statin-like compounds (monacolin K) that may have additive LDL-lowering effects and increase myopathy risk when combined with alirocumab's LDL reduction
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; recommend discussion with prescriber before supplementation

avoid_supplements.name: Niacin (High-dose >2g/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate lipid-lowering effects and increase risk of hyperuricemia or gout in susceptible patients on aggressive lipid therapy
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to recommended dietary amounts; consult clinician before high-dose supplementation

caution_supplements.name: Fish Oil/Omega-3 (≤3g/day)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive modest triglyceride-lowering effects; generally well-tolerated together but may increase bleeding risk if on anticoagulants
caution_supplements.action: Monitor; use standardized products with documented purity

caution_supplements.name: Plant Sterols/Stanols
caution_supplements.mechanism: Complementary cholesterol-lowering mechanism; safe when combined but additive effects may reduce LDL below therapeutic target in some patients
caution_supplements.action: Monitor lipid panel; adjust if LDL becomes suboptimal

caution_foods.name: High saturated fat diet
caution_foods.mechanism: May counteract alirocumab's LDL-lowering efficacy and reduce overall cardiovascular benefit
caution_foods.action: Reinforce heart-healthy diet; emphasize Mediterranean or DASH diet patterns

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: No direct interaction with alirocumab (monoclonal antibody, no CYP metabolism), but relevant if patient also takes statins or other CYP3A4 substrates
caution_foods.action: Relevant only if concurrent statin use; advise moderation or avoidance

monitoring_notes: Alirocumab is a monoclonal antibody with no CYP450 metabolism, minimizing direct drug interactions. Focus monitoring on lipid panel response, myalgia symptoms (especially if concurrent statin use), and adherence to subcutaneous dosing schedule every 2 weeks.
